dashboard.rdp_preview_only: Preview only · turn on “Operate” to click

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Configure and run the daily task queue.
tasks.no_tasks: The queue is empty. Add a task first.
tasks.select_task: Select a task to edit its settings
tasks.drag_hint: Drag tasks to change their order
tasks.demo_warning: MaaCore is not available: runs only demonstrate the UI and never touch the game.

stages.title: Choose battle stages
stages.subtitle: Select multiple stages and order them on the right. Closed stages are skipped at runtime.
stages.plan_empty: No stages selected. Leave empty to use the current/last stage.
stages.plan_hint: Starts from #1 and skips stages that are currently closed.
stages.plan_hint_empty: Leave empty to use the current/last stage.
stages.unknown: Not in the current stage list

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Connection, run, performance, schedule, notifications and appearance.

connection.address_hint: Filled automatically after detection. If detection fails, enter the emulator's real ADB port.
connection.adb_path_placeholder: Leave empty to use the bundled ADB
connection.rdp_host_hint: IP or hostname of the remote Windows machine, e.g. 192.168.10.180.
connection.rdp_user_hint: Remote Windows account; local accounts can use the plain username.
connection.rdp_password_hint: Stored in the local config.json and never written to logs.
connection.rdp_domain_hint: Domain name for domain accounts; leave empty for local accounts.
connection.rdp_resolution_hint: 1920×1080 is recommended; keep the remote game at 16:9, fullscreen and in the foreground.
connection.rdp_game_path_hint: Used by StartUp to launch the remote Arknights client; the close action ends the process named Arknights.
connection.rdp_note: RDP mode opens a local “MaaGO RDP preview” window. MaaCore captures that window and forwards clicks to the remote desktop. MaaGO is not installed on the remote machine; keep the game in the remote foreground.
connection.mode_hint: ADB for emulators/Android devices; Win32 for the local Arknights PC client; RDP for a PC client on a remote Windows machine.
connection.pc_window_hint: Leave empty to derive it from the client type (Official/Bilibili/txwy: 明日方舟).
connection.pc_screencap_hint: PrintWindow is the safest default; try DesktopDupWindow or FramePool if needed.
connection.pc_mouse_hint: Default PostMessageWithWindowPos; some clients need SendMessageWithWindowPos.
connection.pc_keyboard_hint: Default SendMessage; try PostMessage if it does not work.
connection.pc_note: PC mode needs core/MaaWin32ControlUnit.dll. Run MaaGO as administrator if window control fails. Restart after changing the connection mode.
connection.pc_admin_hint: MaaGO is not elevated. The PC client usually runs at high integrity, so Windows blocks screenshot/input without administrator rights (error 5).

run.auto_start_hint: Starts MaaGO hidden in the tray after Windows login. Uses the current-user Run key and does not auto-elevate.
run.only_no_other: Only when no other MaaGO is running
run.post_action_note: Runs after the task queue finishes; currently only closing Arknights is supported.

performance.title: OCR and GPU acceleration
performance.note: Controls the OCR inference device used by MaaCore. Restart MaaGO after changing it.
performance.gpu_ocr_hint: Runs OCR inference on the GPU through DirectML to reduce CPU load. Falls back to CPU automatically.
performance.gpu_device_hint: Usually 0 (default adapter); for multi-GPU systems enter a device index or luid:<hex> adapter ID.
performance.about_ocr: GPU acceleration only affects OCR inference, not screenshots, template matching, or touch input.
performance.about_restart: The OCR provider can only be set before resources load, so a restart is required.
performance.about_fallback: If DirectML is unavailable, MaaCore falls back to CPU automatically.
performance.about_device: Device indices start at 0; keep 0 if unsure.

schedule.force_hint: Stop the current run and start again.
schedule.note: The schedule only runs while MaaGO is open.
schedule.entries_note: Add multiple times per day; each entry has its own weekdays and force-restart setting.
schedule.no_entries: No trigger times yet. Use “Add time” in the top right.

notification.on_error: When a run fails or stops
notification.note: Uses Windows notifications. Third-party push channels are not included.

tray.note: Restore from the tray icon. Use the tray menu's Quit item to exit.

update.proxy_hint: Used for update checks, core downloads and stage data; leave empty to use system/environment proxy.
update.core_source_hint: Choose which MaaCore MaaGO loads at startup. Both cores share base/resource; restart to apply.
update.core_source_custom_hint: ksqeib/MaaCoreBuild nightly in core/, maintained by the Core update section.
update.core_source_official_hint: Official MAA package in base/, replaced by the Base update section.
update.core_source_restart: Core source changed. Restart MaaGO to apply.
update.core_source_missing_base: base/MaaCore.dll is missing. Download the base package first; until then a restart keeps using the custom core.
update.core_hint: Only replaces the custom MaaCore DLLs under core/. The official core is updated with the base package.
update.runtime_unavailable: This core has no deps.json; the runtime check was skipped.
update.runtime_unverified_hint: No matching runtime manifest, so version verification was skipped. If tasks fail, restore the runtime DLLs from a full MAA release.
update.runtime_hint: Checks OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, DirectML and FastDeploy against core/deps.json.
update.runtime_ok_hint: OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, DirectML and FastDeploy are ready.
update.runtime_pending: Runtime dependencies are downloaded; restart MaaGO to install them.
update.runtime_no_source: No runtime pack is available for the versions required by this core; use a full MAA release.
update.core_current_hint: Read from core/.maago-core-version; nightly builds show their build id.
update.target_hint: Empty uses the ksqeib/MaaCoreBuild nightly; you can also enter a specific version such as 0.1.5.
update.mirror_hint: Used for core, base resource and overlay downloads; empty goes directly to GitHub.
update.note: Core update replaces DLLs in core/; base update replaces all of base/; the overlay writes into base/resource. Restart to apply.
update.base_hint: Downloads the full official MAA package into base/, providing both the official core and the shared resource.
update.base_current_hint: Last installed base version; shows — if not marked.
update.base_note: The base package replaces all of base/ with the official release and clears the previous overlay; apply the overlay again afterwards.
update.overlay_hint: Pulls the latest files from the MaaResource main branch and overlays them on the base.
update.overlay_current_hint: Current overlay version; shows — if never updated separately.
update.overlay_note: The overlay only merges files into base/resource and keeps platform_diff/PC. Use it for new events, recruitment and stage data.
update.pending_hint: An update is staged. Restart MaaGO before starting the next update.
update.resource_note: Core, base resource and overlay are downloaded separately. Only one update is staged at a time; restart to apply.
